title: Static review replay recovery
description: Isolated production gateway and real browser controls prove replay refusal without run mutation and a usable same-PR recovery path. A real task workspace and tmux session prove the unacknowledged-start deadline and accepted task progress. No paid reviewer is launched by this recipe. Also verify one same-session output correction and admission of only recoverable saved reviews.

contract-regressions.cmd: PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH" node scripts/quality/run-tsx-tests.mjs --cwd services/gateway --tsconfig tsconfig.json --workers 2 src/review-workspaces/output-repair.test.ts src/runners/native/worker-control-superseded.test.ts src/methods/run.test.ts src/methods/run/replay-step.test.ts
contract-regressions.intent: Correct output once in the same conversation, wait for the new completion, preserve ownership refusals and name Archive for failed duplicates.

recovery-rpc.intent: Real gateway Resume fails an absent reviewer instead of reconciling forever; empty saved replay refuses before mutation, while a valid saved result remains recoverable.

replay-and-request.intent: Review recovery refuses unsafe replay and retains the selected attempt.

startup-deadline.intent: Startup expiry blocks unaccepted work while preserving later genuine progress.
